title: Establish Internal Account profile facts and profile queries
verify: Every supported new target-account path — first bootstrap Admin, invitation participant, and direct-password participant — requires surname and given name and atomically stores trimmed fullName plus immutable server-generated registeredAt.

The current-actor profile query returns only accountId, fullName, role, and registeredAt for a valid session; the statistics profile query returns only accountId, fullName, and registeredAt for requested account IDs.
Invalid, duplicate, revoked, or failed paths leave account, credential/invitation, profile, membership, and session state unchanged; no migration, backfill, or fallback name is introduced.
evidence_required: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-008 / REQ-014 / REQ-017 RED: any supported creation path accepts incomplete names, omits or mutates registeredAt, partially commits profile state, a revoked actor receives current-actor profile facts, or either public query returns fields outside its exact projection; GREEN: isolated creation/query tests prove all three paths, C&S direct-password adapter propagation, atomic failures, immutable timestamp, exact projections, revoked denial, and no migration/backfill/fallback; artifact: .tasks/TASK-094-T3-FT-007-W27/ and .protocols/TASK-094-T3-FT-007-W27/.
purpose: Make the Identity & Access account profile contract complete across every supported new-account path and both accepted profile queries.
success_outcome: Every target Internal Account has authoritative fullName and registeredAt facts that cross only the accepted current-actor or scoped statistics query.
anti_goals: Do not migrate, backfill, infer, or substitute profile data for an existing unnamed account.
Do not let profile facts grant role, center, class, membership, assignment, or session authority.
Do not expose raw Identity & Access rows or fields outside the two named public profile projections.
constraints: Identity & Access exclusively owns account/profile persistence and profile queries; the C&S and route/CLI seams only collect and forward required profile input.

The three supported creation paths use one account profile schema and commit their existing credential, invitation, membership, or parent-link state atomically under the accepted Account Provisioning Boundary.
Accounts without profile facts remain outside the accepted target population.
invariants: fullName is trimmed required surname plus given name and registeredAt is generated once by the server.
Profile facts never alter authorization or session behavior.
Only the named Identity & Access queries return profile fields; raw account rows never cross a capability boundary.
verification_targets: .memory-bank/features/FT-007-navigation-and-statistics.md#FT-007-AC-008: all-path creation including the C&S direct-password seam, exact current-actor/scoped projections, immutable timestamp, rollback, revoked denial, and no-legacy matrix.

stop_conditions: Stop if implementation requires migration, backfill, fallback names, or legacy-account compatibility.
Stop if profile completion requires a new public owner/edge or files outside the listed Identity & Access, C&S adapter, Admin transport, bootstrap, and focused test seams.
